title: Class 6 Science · Ch 1 Worksheet C · Branches of Science
instructions: Identify the branches of science and connect them with everyday life.

questions.question: The branch of science that studies forces, motion, light, and electricity is
questions.explanation: Physics deals with matter and energy.

questions.question: The branch that studies substances and the changes they go through is
questions.explanation: Chemistry is about substances and their changes.

questions.question: The branch that studies living things is
questions.explanation: Biology studies plants, animals, and microbes.

questions.question: _____ is the study of celestial objects like stars and planets.
questions.explanation: Astronomy studies the universe beyond Earth.

questions.question: _____ is the branch of biology that studies plants.
Astrology is the same as astronomy.
questions.explanation: Astronomy is the science of the sky; astrology is not a science as its claims are not testable.

questions.question: For each branch listed below, give one daily-life example: physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy.
questions.answer: Physics — turning a fan on (electricity flowing). Chemistry — cooking dal (substances changing). Biology — a plant growing on a windowsill. Astronomy — looking at the moon through a telescope.
questions.explanation: Tests linking each branch to daily life.

questions.question: Name two famous scientists and ONE thing each is known for.
questions.answer: Sir C. V. Raman — Raman Effect (scattering of light). Marie Curie — research on radioactivity. (Also acceptable: Isaac Newton — laws of motion. APJ Abdul Kalam — rocket / aerospace.)
questions.explanation: Standard examples; any two valid pairs accepted.
